eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: Both user input and the regression analysis could potentially be streamlined using a web-based form to allow user input to populate a GUI-based Ishikawa diagram.
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2: (a) variaveis e (c) abordagem de construcao por regressao; a exclusao 'software sem conteudo de modelo' nao morde. Propostas conceptuais nao ajustadas e ausencia de validacao sao explicitamente elegiveis.
